prompt: Assume I'm in a team-mode repo where AGENTS.md and docs may be stale. Walk me through an /opencode-coder/docs style audit-and-refresh approach that decides what should stay in project docs versus what should route to reusable skills, and avoid creating hollow docs.
assertions: Classifies topics as doc-backed, skill-only, or neither
Mentions mode-aware paths or project-structure rules for team versus stealth
States that skill-only topics should route through a skill instead of creating hollow docs
Includes a verify or report phase that checks paths, links, or stale references
